coverage: All5 allocation failures; notifier registration and batch publish failures; successful init/exit; huge get/put lengths; read_only write rejection; RPC open errors; close work admission; late RX while retired; VM recreation failures; explicit module-GOING close.
limitation: Whole actual driver C with deterministic host lock/FIFO/work services. Real workqueue concurrency, firmware RPC behavior, and TTY I/O still require kernel/phone validation.
publication_scope: Local actual-C lifecycle evidence for this exact source hash; its external fixture is not a portable CI input.
